name: Flisk CLI
tagline: Run your whole AI-built app on your own laptop with one command: flisk up
description: Flisk discovers your services, generates the local config and runs them with live reload on Docker and Tilt. Open source (MIT). Works with Claude Code, Codex and Cursor.
author: flisk-sh

name: README Score
tagline: Your README, scored out of 100, with a fix for every miss
description: Enter a GitHub repository or paste a README and get a score out of 100, the sections found and missing, and a fix for each miss.
author: flisk-sh

name: Citable
tagline: Can AI answers cite your site? Put citable.flisk.si/ in front of any address
description: Reads a page the way ChatGPT search, Claude and Perplexity crawlers do, scores it out of 100 and says what keeps it out of their answers, with the fix.
author: flisk-sh

name: Helpdock
tagline: Any GitHub repo's docs, as a help center and an MCP server
description: Replace github.com with helpdock.flisk.sh in a repository address to browse its docs, get answers quoted from the exact page, and add the docs to your AI over MCP.
author: flisk-sh

name: Command Comparer
tagline: Flisk next to Terraform, Docker Compose, Tilt and more, command by command
description: Commands side by side across many tabs, with a source link for every cell.
author: flisk-sh

name: Pages
tagline: Your agent builds a page. One command makes it a link
description: Publish an interactive page to pages.flisk.si/@your-login/name. Free and public, no keys, no database: every page is a git branch.
author: flisk-sh

name: DevEx Roadmap
tagline: A community-edited map of developer tools, roles and agent skills
description: Compass, Adoption Radar, Lab, Journeys, Roles, Skills, Portfolio and Ask: hundreds of tools and 400 agent skills, drawn eight ways.
author: flisk-sh

name: Flisk Demos
tagline: A personalised Flisk demo for what you build
description: Open demo.flisk.sh/your-handle/what-you-build-in-dashes and get a demo stack made for you.
author: flisk-sh

name: FliskOS
tagline: One local window for your Flisk projects, agents and apps
description: Projects and their health, coding agents working on them, and the other Flisk apps. Runs on your machine and holds no keys.
author: flisk-sh

name: Flisk Import
tagline: Turn a Docker Compose file into Flisk services
description: Imports the services in a repository's docker-compose.yml into Flisk as service.json files. Use --dry-run to see the plan first.
author: flisk-sh

name: md2html
tagline: GitHub-flavored Markdown to HTML that is safe to put in a page
description: A configured markdown-it and sanitize-html: tables, task lists, alerts and the HTML that READMEs carry, rendered the way GitHub renders a README.
author: flisk-sh

name: Service Definitions
tagline: A community registry of Flisk apps, one service.json per app
description: Apps imported with flisk-import and validated against the Flisk service schema, the way DefinitelyTyped publishes types.
author: flisk-sh

name: Flisk Tools
tagline: This store: every dev tool, agent skill and app, searchable and open source
description: A free marketplace of developer tools, AI agent skills and apps. Search it, add yours with a pull request after signing in with GitHub, or let your AI search it over MCP.
author: flisk-sh
